description: This file contains a PHP unit test class named MembershipDaoTest, which tests the methods of the MembershipDao class related to managing Membership entities, including add, edit, retrieve, delete, and validation of membership data.

classes.name: MembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MembershipDao data access object methods related to Membership management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a new MembershipDao instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAddMembership
methods.description: Tests the saving of a new Membership entity and verifies the correct data is persisted.

methods.name: testEditMembership
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Membership entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Membership entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific Membership entity by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple Membership entities by their IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete a non-existing Membership record and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Tests the validation method to check if a membership name already exists, case-insensitive and with whitespace variations.
